title: Laguerre-Sobolev orthogonal Polynomials and Boundary Value Problems on a semi-infinite domain
summary: We study a family of Laguerre--Sobolev orthogonal polynomials associated with a Sobolev inner product arising from second--order boundary value problems on the semi--infinite interval $(0,+\infty)$. These polynomials generate an orthogonal basis of test functions vanishing at the endpoints and are especially well suited for the spectral approximation of Schrödinger--type problems with singular potentials.
